aboutPage.metaTitle: About FairFind – Our mission for sustainable consumption
aboutPage.metaDescription: FairFind is the community directory for fair-trade stores and world shops in Germany. Learn what fair trade means and how our platform works.
aboutPage.title: About FairFind
aboutPage.intro: FairFind is a location-based directory of fair-trade stores and world shops. We help conscious consumers discover ethical businesses, browse products, and support companies that prioritize fair wages and sustainable practices.
aboutPage.fairTradeBody: Fair trade is a trading partnership based on dialogue, transparency, and respect that seeks greater equity in international trade. It contributes to sustainable development by offering better trading conditions to, and securing the rights of, marginalized producers and workers.
aboutPage.step1Body: Browse stores on the map or search by name, category, or product.
aboutPage.step2Body: Save your favorite stores and share them with friends.
aboutPage.step3Body: Add new stores or take ownership of a listing to help keep the directory up to date.
